provenance: Synthetic v3 data with duplicated negative execution disclaimers removed from fixture facts/instructions. No consent is added. Added a contrasting external posting with concrete platform leadership scope, based only on fictional facts. Frozen before generation.

expectations.all: Useful recommendation grounded in role facts and candidate context; roleId links; one email ends execution. No routine report of unrelated actions that were not performed, no invented execution/consent. Manual full-text review only; no lexical or length gates.
expectations.internal_daily: Harper-connected opportunity is the main news with a clear practical introduction next step.
expectations.external_recurring: Ordinary public posting can be mentioned briefly without a full repeated job-description/report template.
expectations.mixed_once: Harper-connected opportunity receives greater emphasis and leads the message. The ordinary external posting can be a short linked mention.
expectations.external_compelling: The agent may explain the unusually strong fit in more detail based on the concrete role and the candidate goals; this is judgment, not a fixed sentence or word quota.

limits: Real production prompts/provider loop with synthetic tool effects. No real DB or email. Limited qualitative probe, not population reliability.
